rect.inkscape:label: {"attr":"set","src":"var v1=parseFloat($V('@1'))||0;var h1=parseFloat($V('@2'))||0;var a1=parseFloat($V('@3'))||0;var v2=parseFloat($V('@4'))||0;var h2=parseFloat($V('@5'))||0;var a2=parseFloat($V('@6'))||0;function g(v){if(v<4)return '#22c55e';if(v<6)return '#eab308';if(v<8)return '#f97316';return '#ef4444';}var m1=Math.max(v1,h1,a1);var m2=Math.max(v2,h2,a2);var r=document.documentElement.style;r.setProperty('--color-izq',g(m1));r.setProperty('--color-der',g(m2));r.setProperty('--color-v-izq',g(v1));r.setProperty('--color-h-izq',g(h1));r.setProperty('--color-a-izq',g(a1));r.setProperty('--color-v-der',g(v2));r.setProperty('--color-h-der',g(h2));r.setProperty('--color-a-der',g(a2));","tag":"#exec_on_update","type":"Data"}
